fake_signature.label: Fake signature
fake_signature.reason: The adviser's signature doesn't match the specimen. Fakes are rejected.

identity_mismatch.label: Details don't match the record
identity_mismatch.reason: The birthday on the admission slip doesn't match ISMIS. Resetting would hand someone else's account over.

failed_prereq.label: Failed prerequisite (5.0)
failed_prereq.reason: A 5.0 in the prerequisite means they can't take this subject yet.

wrong_department.label: Wrong department today
wrong_department.reason: Their department isn't on today's extension list. Only listed departments may adjust.

missing_requirement.label: Missing requirement
missing_requirement.reason: A clearance requirement is missing. Return the form with the list.

unpaid_balance.label: Unpaid balance
unpaid_balance.reason: ISMIS shows an unpaid balance. The Cashier comes first.

missing_signature.label: Missing adviser signature
missing_signature.reason: Adding a subject needs the adviser's signature. Send them to Consultation.

inc_prereq.label: INC in prerequisite
inc_prereq.reason: An INC in the prerequisite needs the adviser's go-ahead at Consultation.

overload.label: Overload (over 24 units)
overload.reason: Over 24 units is an overload. Only the Dean's office can approve it.

ismis_login.label: ISMIS login issue
ismis_login.reason: Their ISMIS account is locked. Reset it at the window.

closed_section.label: Closed section
closed_section.reason: The section is full. Find an open section that doesn't clash.
